title: 15-Minute Fried Rice
description: The ultimate quick, fridge-clearing meal that hits the spot every single time. Best made with day-old cold rice.

blocks.alt: Fried rice cooked in a rustic cast iron skillet

blocks.text: Got leftover rice? Excellent. This 15-minute fried rice is the easiest weeknight dinner you will ever make. Toss in any veggies you have lurking in your crisper drawer.

items.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add beaten eggs and scramble until just set. Remove from skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining oil and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add minced garlic, peas, and carrots. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add the cold cooked rice to the skillet. Use a spatula to break up any clumps. Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until the rice gets slightly toasted.
Drizzle the soy sauce and sesame oil over the rice. Toss to coat evenly.
Fold in the scrambled eggs and sliced green onions. Stir-fry for another minute and serve hot.

blocks.text: Cold, day-old rice is essential! Freshly cooked rice is too wet and will make the dish mushy.
